messages.text: Could you make an ad for FitTrack using both of these attached screenshots, the home screen pic and the workout screen pic? I’m excited to see the app presented as an ad, because I’ve been trying to imagine how it would feel in motion. The look should be clean and energetic, and somewhere in all that it needs to be 10 seconds long in widescreen 16:9. Please show the home screen first, then the workout screen, and finish with the app name, FitTrack. I’d like an upbeat instrumental beat with no voiceover, and any other copy is your call.
